description: The strategy module (packages/core/docs/genre-mechanics.md §5): holdings are a world’s businesses, the board is its settlements, a holding yields per hand per turn by its trade, workers are residents of the settlement and eat, and a strict majority of a settlement’s trading businesses is control. Each kb opens with packages/core/src/strategy/strategy-predicates.ts verbatim; regenerate with npm run genre-mechanics-corpus. Integer arithmetic only. World cases run over conformance/genre-mechanics/thistlecombe.world-slice.json, a slice of a real Insimul world (the Unity closing-wave export of Thistlecombe) cut by npm run genre-world-slice; their facts are what core’s generators produce from it and their expectations are what core’s TypeScript resolution says.

cases.name: a-bare-kb-has-no-income-and-does-not-raise
kb: strategy_sum([X | T], S) :- strategy_sum(T, S0), S is S0 + X.
strategy_length([_ | T], N) :- strategy_length(T, N0), N is N0 + 1.
strategy_holding_in(F, B, S) :- strategy_holds(F, B), business_of_settlement(B, S).
strategy_stock_of(F, Res, Amount) :- nonvar(F), strategy_resource(Res), ( strategy_stock(F, Res, A0) -> Amount = A0 ; Amount = 0 ).
strategy_hands(B, Hands) :- findall(W, strategy_worker(B, W), Ws), strategy_length(Ws, N), Hands is N + 1.
strategy_output(B, Res, Amount) :- strategy_trading(B), business_type(B, T), strategy_trade_output(T, Res, Per), strategy_hands(B, Hands), Amount is Per * Hands.
strategy_income(F, Res, Total) :- strategy_faction(F), strategy_resource(Res), findall(A, (strategy_holds(F, B), strategy_output(B, Res, A)), As), strategy_sum(As, Total).

strategy_upkeep(F, Res, Total) :- strategy_faction(F), strategy_resource(Res), findall(W, (strategy_holds(F, B), strategy_worker(B, W)), Ws), strategy_length(Ws, N), ( strategy_worker_upkeep(Res, Per) -> true ; Per = 0 ), Total is N * Per.
strategy_net(F, Res, Net) :- strategy_income(F, Res, In), strategy_upkeep(F, Res, Out), Net is In - Out.
strategy_shortfall(F, Res, Short) :- strategy_net(F, Res, Net), strategy_stock_of(F, Res, Have), Short is 0 - (Have + Net), Short > 0.
strategy_claim_price(B, Res, Amount) :- business_type(B, T), strategy_claim_cost(T, _, _), !, strategy_claim_cost(T, Res, Amount).
strategy_claim_price(B, Res, Amount) :- business(B), strategy_default_claim_cost(Res, Amount).
strategy_cannot_afford(F, B) :- strategy_claim_price(B, Res, Cost), strategy_stock_of(F, Res, Have), Have < Cost.
strategy_frontier(F, S) :- strategy_controls(F, S0), ( strategy_adjacent(S0, S) ; strategy_adjacent(S, S0) ).
strategy_can_claim(F, B) :- nonvar(F), strategy_faction(F), strategy_trading(B), \+ strategy_holds(F, B), business_of_settlement(B, S), \+ \+ strategy_frontier(F, S), \+ strategy_cannot_afford(F, B).
strategy_resident_of(W, S) :- lives_at(W, R), residence_of_settlement(R, S).

strategy_can_assign(F, W, B) :- nonvar(F), nonvar(W), strategy_holds(F, B), strategy_trading(B), business_of_settlement(B, S), strategy_resident_of(W, S), \+ strategy_worker(_, W), findall(X, strategy_worker(B, X), Xs), strategy_length(Xs, N), strategy_workers_per_holding(Max), N < Max.
strategy_trading_in(S, N) :- settlement(S), findall(B, (business_of_settlement(B, S), strategy_trading(B)), Bs), strategy_length(Bs, N).
strategy_held_in(F, S, N) :- findall(B, (strategy_holding_in(F, B, S), strategy_trading(B)), Bs), strategy_length(Bs, N).

strategy_held_in(F, S, N) :- findall(B, (strategy_holding_in(F, B, S), strategy_trading(B)), Bs), strategy_length(Bs, N).
strategy_controls(F, S) :- strategy_faction(F), strategy_trading_in(S, Total), Total > 0, strategy_held_in(F, S, Held), 2 * Held > Total.
strategy_victory(F) :- nonvar(F), strategy_faction(F), \+ (strategy_trading_in(S, Total), Total > 0, \+ strategy_controls(F, S)), \+ \+ strategy_controls(F, _).
